title: Salt + Sand Retreat | Royal Destinations
meta_description: This new construction home in Seacrest Beach offers spacious living, multiple suites, an outdoor pool and lanai. Surround yourself in coastal elegance. Enjoy public beach access within walking distance. Located just minutes from Rosemary and Alys Beach
description_expanded: Description: Salt + Sand Retreat by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 518 Seacrest Drive, Inlet Beach, FL Details: Discover a luxurious retreat at Seacrest Beach, your new favorite getaway destination, Salt + Sand Retreat. Nestled off 30A, this newly constructed beach house perfectly blends comfort and style, offering an unparalleled vacation experience for families and friends alike. Step inside to find all-new, top-quality furnishings that add a touch of elegance to every room. The entertainment paradise features a game/ping pong room, ensuring fun and laughter are guaranteed, ideal for friendly competitions and making lasting memories. Relax in the serene atmosphere of your private pool and lanai, perfect for sunbathing, swimming, or enjoying a quiet evening under the stars. Outdoor dining and seating options make it easy to enjoy meals al fresco with the soothing sounds of nature as your backdrop. For those who love to cook or entertain, the gourmet kitchen is equipped with all new housewares and professional-grade appliances, ensuring every meal is a culinary delight. The interiors are thoughtfully designed by professionals, offering a blend of style and comfort that makes every space inviting. Stay connected and entertained with smart TVs throughout the house, offering streaming services. With spacious accommodations, there's enough room for your entire family, extended family, and friends, ensuring everyone has their own space to relax and enjoy. Whether you seek a peaceful retreat or a lively family vacation, this beach house in Seacrest Beach off 30A provides the perfect setting for an unforgettable experience. Book your stay now and be among the first to enjoy this luxurious home away from home. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: The End of Seacrest Drive - Private Pool - Ping Pong/Game Room - Gas Grill - Bikes Provided for Exploring 30A - Dining Accommodations: 14 - Parking Spaces: 4 * Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). * The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. * Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Seacrest West Community Overview: - The Big Chill to the West - Short Distance to Alys and Rosemary Beach to the East Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 5 Bedrooms / 4.5 Baths First Floor: - Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed and Private Bath - Guest Bedroom 2: King Bed Shared Bath - Guest Bedroom 3: King Bed Shared Bath - Access to Pool Deck and Outdoor Living - Kitchen / Living / Dining / Game Room / Half Bath - Laundry Room Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom 4: King bed with Private Bath - Guest Bedroom 5: Two Twin/Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bath - Upstairs Family Media Room - Queen Sleeper Sofa Amenities Include: - 6 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
